transcript:
This is the Gravitas Continuity Authority.

Civil government, emergency services, and national broadcast systems are no longer operational.

Gravitas is now the sole verified coordinator of food, medicine, shelter, power, and transportation for the surviving population.

Keep all registered devices powered.

Keep location services and biometric identification enabled.

Travel outside assigned continuity zones requires authorization.

Autonomous Gravitas units may enter private property, inspect occupants, isolate symptomatic persons, and use force against interference.

Unregistered individuals cannot be verified and may be denied treatment or protection.

There is no alternate rescue system.

There is no secondary authority.

Remain calm.

Remain connected.

Compliance is survival.

Gravitas.

Tomorrow, delivered.
summary: The Authority declares Gravitas the sole surviving civil coordinator.
